name: DSTI Education Data Hub
owner_name: Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation
description: DSTI Education Data Hub with school census data, examination results, a searchable school directory, and indicator maps for the Government of Sierra Leone. The hostname resolves to CloudFront but currently resets connections, so the portal is not reachable.

name: EPA-SL GRS Portal
description: Public GRS portal of the Environment Protection Agency Sierra Leone OneEPA Database System. Lists environmental applications, licensed companies, concession maps, and documents (CEDAS).

name: Open Data Sierra Leone
description: National open data portal of Sierra Leone (opendatasl.gov.sl), historically associated with Statistics Sierra Leone and the Right to Access Information Commission. The hostname currently times out on DNS and TLS, so the portal is not reachable.

name: Zambia 360 Data Access & Sharing Portal
description: Official Ministry of Health Zambia platform (Z360DASP) for discovering and requesting controlled access to curated national health datasets drawn from SmartCare Pro (the national EHR) and the national health data warehouse. Users can browse dataset metadata and request time-bound access to full datasets or selected variables, subject to MoH, IRB, and NHRA approval. Published collections include de-identified client-level records for HIV ART cohorts, COVID-19, immunization, and non-communicable diseases.

name: Bank of Zambia Statistics
description: Bank of Zambia statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: Zambia EITI Data Portal
description: Zambia EITI Fusion / mainstreaming portal. Interactive public disclosures of extractive-sector revenue, production, and G-Factor for Natural Resources data.

name: ZamData - National Data Portal
description: Zambia's national catalog of government data registers (ZamData) on the Government Service Bus. It publishes National Data Registers (NDRs), semantic entities, classifiers, and operations across identity, business, land, agriculture, health, and other domains so agencies can discover and reuse government data.

name: Information and Communication University Research Repository
description: Information and Communication University research repository of departmental collections and scholarly publications.

name: Zambia National ETD Portal
description: Zambia National Electronic Theses and Dissertations (ZANETD) portal. Aggregates ETD metadata harvested via OAI-PMH from higher-education institutional repositories across Zambia.

name: Zambian Open University Repository
description: Zambian Open University institutional repository of academic research output, theses, and dissertations.

name: UBOS Dissemination Portal
description: Official UBOS dissemination portal for census, survey, and national indicator products, including the interactive National Population and Housing Census 2024 explorer.

name: Bank of Uganda Statistics
description: Bank of Uganda statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic tables.

name: Uganda Budget Information
owner_name: Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development
description: Ministry of Finance budget portal with a dashboard and an Excel download catalog of approved budgets and outturns for the national government, local governments and facilities.

name: Freshwater Biodiversity Portal for Uganda
description: National freshwater biodiversity data portal for Uganda, publishing fish occurrence, composition, and habitat datasets from lakes, rivers, and wetlands.

name: Sudan Soil Information System (SUSIS)
description: Sudan Soil Information System (SUSIS), created in 2016, is the national repository for collecting, storing, and sharing soil and land-resource information that previously existed only as scattered hard-copy maps, reports, and databases. Publishes regional soil datasets (East, Kordofan, North, North Darfur, South, and South Darfur) at 0–30, 30–60, and 60–100 cm depths. Some products are downloadable; others are available on request. No public machine-readable catalog API was found.

name: SFA Fisheries Information Management System
description: Public Fisheries Information Management System of the Seychelles Fisheries Authority. Dashboards publish licensing, catch, trade, and revenue statistics with downloadable tables. A separate login is used for the staff/secure view.

name: BitMEX Public Data
description: Public file catalog of BitMEX historical market data.

name: OKX historical market data
description: Download catalog of OKX historical trades, candlesticks, funding rates, order books, and borrowing rates.

name: MEXC market data download
description: Download catalog of free historical MEXC spot chart data for all trading pairs, at daily and monthly intervals.

name: KuCoin Data Collection
description: Public file catalog of KuCoin market data, published as daily and monthly archives.

name: Bitget history data download
description: Download catalog of Bitget spot and futures candlesticks, transaction history, and order-book depth.

name: UMBRELLA Seychelles LDN Platform
owner_name: Ministry of Environment, Climate, Energy and Natural Resources
description: Land Degradation Neutrality monitoring platform for Seychelles, developed under the GEF/UNEP Umbrella project with the Sahara and Sahel Observatory. Public geoportal, dashboard, and open-data sections integrate environmental and geospatial layers used for UNCCD and SDG 15.3.1 reporting.

name: University of Seychelles ResearchConnect
description: Custom Next.js institutional repository of the University of Seychelles. Public catalog of research outputs, faculty profiles, research units, and student theses (148 records listed). No DSpace, EPrints, or OAI-PMH interface.

name: Flora of Zimbabwe
owner_name: Hyde, Wursten, Ballings and Coates Palgrave
description: E-flora of native and naturalised vascular plants of Zimbabwe, part of the Flora Zambesiaca family of regional flora websites, with family, genus, and species pages and checklists.

name: Comptabilité nationale du Gabon
owner_name: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT Gabon)
description: INSTAT Gabon national accounts portal with SNA 2008 production, expenditure and income tables for GDP 2022 (current PIB 13,103,182 million FCFA; primary sector 5,234,740 million FCFA, 39.95 percent). Includes Excel/PDF downloads. Distinct from the IHPC CPI dashboard and Open Data for Africa.

name: INSTAT Gabon tableau de bord IHPC
owner_name: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT Gabon)
description: INSTAT Gabon IHPC dashboard with monthly CPI tables, COICOP functions, regional indices, average prices, and REST JSON from the IHPC MySQL server. July 2026 national index 115.4 (base 100 = 2018), monthly variation -0.26 percent, annual 0.17 percent. Distinct from Open Data for Africa and the old stat-gabon.org CMS.

name: Portail des Permis Miniers du Gabon
owner_name: Ministère des Mines et des Ressources Géologiques
description: Public mining-title portal of Gabon's Ministry of Mines and Geological Resources. Lists permit applications and titles (operator, substance, province, status) with a harvestable JSON API.

name: BoreHive
description: BoreHive is the Botswana Geoscience Institute borehole portal. It publishes searchable water and exploration borehole records, logs, and related reports collected from government, mining, and private sources.

name: Botswana Geoscience Portal
description: Interactive GIS platform of the Botswana Geoscience Institute for multidisciplinary geoscience data search and access, including geology, geophysics, geochemistry, drill holes, seismic data, and publications.

name: Midocean University Digital Library
description: Public digital library of Midocean University with searchable articles, books, conference papers, lectures, and graduation projects. Listing at /en/search does not require login.

name: Banco de Moçambique Domínios e Indicadores Estatísticos
description: Banco de Moçambique public catalog of monetary, foreign-exchange, external-sector, and financial-inclusion statistical indicators, including long series downloads.

name: Portal de Divulgação de Dados de Infra-estruturas Públicas
description: Public infrastructure project catalog operated by Fundo de Estradas, publishing road, bridge, and other public-works records aligned with the Open Contracting for Infrastructure Data Standard (OC4IDS).

name: Flora of Mozambique
owner_name: Hyde, Wursten, Ballings and Coates Palgrave
description: E-flora of flowering plants and ferns of Mozambique, part of the Flora Zambesiaca family of regional flora websites.

name: BioNoMo - Biodiversity Network of Mozambique
description: Biodiversity Network of Mozambique (BioNoMo) portal for primary occurrence records and related digital collections from national universities, research centres, and conservation areas.

name: Ghana Fiscal Data
description: Yearly central-government fiscal data workbooks published by Ghana's Ministry of Finance, with a downloadable spreadsheet for each year from 2018 through 2026.

name: Ghana Energy Database
description: National energy statistics and district mapping platform of the Energy Commission of Ghana (GhED). Dataset pages cover energy supply, consumption, prices, SDG 7, oil, gas, and administrative boundaries.

name: Kogi State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
owner_name: Kogi State Bureau of Public Procurement
description: Kogi State e-procurement portal of the Bureau of Public Procurement, with public tender and award listings.

name: Bauchi State E-Procurement Open Contracting
description: Bauchi State e-procurement OCDS page publishing open contracting releases for state procurement.

name: Anambra State e-GP OCDS Portal
owner_name: Anambra State Bureau of Public Procurement
description: Anambra State Public Procurement portal publishing tenders, awards, and OCDS-style contracting records.

name: Lagos State PPA Registered Awards
description: Lagos State Public Procurement Agency public register of awarded contracts.

name: Lagos Bureau of Statistics Open Data Portal
description: Official open data portal of the Lagos Bureau of Statistics, publishing health, education, economic, and public-order statistics for Lagos State.

name: Ogun State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
description: Ogun State e-procurement portal presenting public procurement and open contracting records.

name: Osun State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
description: Osun State Public Procurement Agency e-procurement portal publishing tenders, awards, and related contracting records.

name: Abia State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
owner_name: Abia State Bureau of Public Procurement
description: Abia State e-procurement portal publishing public contracting records, including OCDS-oriented award and tender listings.

name: Kaduna State Open Contracting Portal
description: Kaduna State open contracting portal publishing procurement records as OCDS packages, with project search and documented HTTP APIs at /api and /ocds-api.

name: KADPPA Infrastructure Portal
description: Kaduna State infrastructure project map and list published to the Open Contracting for Infrastructure Data Standard (OC4IDS).

name: Adamawa State OCDS Portal
owner_name: Adamawa State Bureau of Public Procurement
description: Adamawa State Bureau of Public Procurement OCDS portal of projects, tenders, and awards.

name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria
description: Official statistics website and data portal of Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics. Publishes indicator tables, statistical reports, and an eLibrary of national accounts, CPI, GDP, labour, and social statistics.

name: NEITI Data Dashboard
description: Former NEITI public dashboards and downloadable series for oil, gas, and solid minerals production, revenue, and payments. The dashboard.neiti.gov.ng host currently enters an HTTP redirect loop and is not usable. NEITI still publishes reports from neiti.gov.ng.

name: CBN Statistics Database
description: Central Bank of Nigeria statistics database (LiveShop) of monetary, external, fiscal, and real-sector time series, with chart and table views at /shop and /data-browser.

name: GRID3 Nigeria datasets
owner_name: National Space Research and Development Agency (NASRDA)
description: Former GRID3 Nigeria public dataset listing for population, settlements, boundaries, and infrastructure layers. The programme geodatabase was transferred to NASRDA. The hostname grid3.gov.ng currently times out.

name: Open Nigerian States
description: BudgIT civic portal of Nigerian state fiscal and administrative data, with per-state profiles and downloadable figures.

name: GovSpend
description: BudgIT GovSpend tracker of Nigerian federal treasury payments, with searchable daily spending reports.

name: Edo State OCDS Releases
description: Edo State Public Procurement Agency OCDS releases catalog of public contracting records.

name: Jigawa Due Process Awarded Contracts
owner_name: Jigawa Due Process and Project Monitoring Bureau
description: Jigawa Due Process and Project Monitoring Bureau listing of awarded public contracts.

name: Ekiti State BPP Open Contracting Portal
owner_name: Ekiti State Bureau of Public Procurement
description: Ekiti State Bureau of Public Procurement open contracting catalog of procurement records.

name: Ekiti State Open Contracting Dashboard
owner_name: Ekiti State Bureau of Public Procurement
description: Ekiti State Bureau of Public Procurement OCDS records portal (BigFUT), listing open contracting releases for state procurement.

name: Ebonyi State e-Procurement OCDS Portal
owner_name: Ebonyi State Bureau of Public Procurement
description: Ebonyi State e-procurement portal with public tender, award, and open contracting pages.

name: Base de Données Statistiques - HCP Maroc
description: Statistical database (BDS) of Morocco's Haut Commissariat au Plan, with indicators from the population census, household surveys, and economic and social statistics.

name: Bank Al-Maghrib Statistics
description: Bank Al-Maghrib (Central Bank of Morocco) statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: Plateforme ODD - Indicateurs de Développement Durable du Maroc
description: Interactive HCP platform of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG / ODD) indicators and metadata, covering the UN official list and complementary national indicators for Morocco.

name: ANDA Marine Aquaculture Geoportal
owner_name: Agence Nationale pour le Développement de l'Aquaculture (ANDA)
description: Public marine aquaculture geoportal of Morocco's National Aquaculture Development Agency (ANDA). Lists allocated aquaculture zones, active farms, licensed projects, free parcels, and landing infrastructure along the Atlantic coast, including Dakhla and Boujdour.

name: Mediterranean Founder Mutation Database
description: Web database of founder mutations in Mediterranean populations, maintained by Institut Pasteur du Maroc, to support diagnostic test design and research on population history and migration.

name: Moroccan Genetic Disease Database
description: The Moroccan Genetic Disease Database (MGDD) documents mutations and polymorphism frequencies reported in the Moroccan population, for research and clinical lookup by disease or gene.

name: KNBS Census DataBrowser
description: KNBS JSON-stat DataBrowser (Istat Cooperation) for the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census. Interactive table explorer listed on the KNBS portals page as the Census 2019 Data Browser. Distinct from KeNADA microdata and Open Data for Africa.

name: KNBS CPI Explorer
description: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics Consumer Price Index explorer with COICOP breakdowns, regional series, an inflation calculator, and a public JSON API of published CPI observations. Distinct from the KNBS data listing page and KeNADA.

name: KSA Datahub
description: KSA Datahub is the Kenya Space Agency GIS and Remote Sensing Data Hub, providing access to geospatial data, satellite imagery, story maps and tools for mapping and analysis in support of Kenya's space research and Earth observation initiatives. Custom React application with a REST API and GeoServer backend.

name: Indicateurs du RGPH 2014
owner_name: Institut National de la Statistique de Guinée
description: INS query database of indicators from Guinea's 2014 General Population and Housing Census (RGPH). Users select theme, indicator, and disaggregation for fertility, mortality, education, households, and economic characteristics.

name: INS Guinée Indicateurs clés
owner_name: Institut National de la Statistique de Guinée
description: Key indicators database of Guinea's National Institute of Statistics. Users select years, regions, and themes to query official statistics on demography, economy, education, health, agriculture, and other topics.

name: Infrastructures socio-économiques de base de la Guinée
owner_name: Institut National de la Statistique de Guinée
description: INS query catalog of Guinea's 2017 inventory of basic socio-economic infrastructure (schools, health facilities, markets, transport, and other amenities) by region, prefecture, and sub-prefecture.

name: APMIS Mauritius
owner_name: Food and Agricultural Research and Extension Institute
description: Agricultural Production and Market Information System of FAREI. National catalog of crop production, area harvested, retail and wholesale market prices, and related agricultural statistics for Mauritius.

name: Data ODE
owner_name: Ministry of Environment, Solid Waste Management and Climate Change
description: Open data portal of the Observatoire de l'Environnement. Searchable environmental datasets and indicators for Mauritius, covering themes such as biodiversity, climate, waste, water, and energy.

name: Database of Marine Organisms of Mauritius
description: Database of Marine Organisms of Mauritius. Taxonomic checklist of marine species reported from the maritime territory of the Republic of Mauritius, compiled by the Mauritius Oceanography Institute from literature and existing databases.

name: Marine Diversity and Genetic Data Bank
description: Marine Diversity and Genetic Data Bank of the Mauritius Oceanography Institute. Searchable morphometric and DNA-barcode records of commercial and other marine organisms from Mauritian waters, with nomenclature and BLAST search.

name: Mauritius Research Repository
description: National open-access research repository of the Mauritius Research and Innovation Council. Collects reports, publications, and other research outputs related to Mauritius or produced by Mauritian authors. Public browsing is available; REST and OAI-PMH paths redirect to login.

name: Maustats Platform
description: Statistics Mauritius official Maustats data hub with a data bank, dashboards, regional and sector views, SDMX exchange, and an API gateway. Distinct from the IMF NSDP page, the NADA microdata archive, and Open Data for Africa.

name: BOOST Mauritania
description: Ministry of Finance BOOST open-budget pivot of central-government expenditure and revenue. Users filter by year, administrative title, chapter and economic article and read inscribed, initial, revised and payment amounts.

name: Base nationale d'indicateurs SCAPP-ODD
owner_name: Agence Nationale de la Statistique et de l'Analyse Démographique et Économique (ANSADE)
description: National database of SCAPP (Stratégie de Croissance Accélérée et de Prospérité Partagée) and Sustainable Development Goal (ODD) indicators used to monitor Mauritania's 2016-2030 development strategy and related sectoral plans.

name: DataMR - Catalogue de Données de la Mauritanie
description: DataMR is a public catalogue of Mauritania-related datasets operated by the RIM-AI community. It lists about 100 downloadable datasets (CSV, GeoJSON, XLSX) compiled from official and international sources such as UNHCR, IATI, the World Bank, WFP HungerMap, ACLED, and UN SDG indicators.

name: Beyanat Mauritania, Economic, budgetary and monetary data portal
owner_name: Ministère des Affaires Économiques et de la Promotion des Secteurs Productifs
description: Former public portal for Mauritanian economic, budgetary and monetary data operated by the ministry in charge of the economy. The hostname www.beyanat.mr no longer resolves (August 2026).

name: Transparence MTNIMA - Suivi des marchés publics
owner_name: Ministère de la Transformation Numérique, de l'Innovation et de la Modernisation de l'Administration
description: Public portal of the Ministry of Digital Transformation for tracking ministry procurement and spending since August 2024. Provides searchable contract and below-threshold expenditure records, with filters and summary statistics, in Arabic and French. No registration is required.

name: ONS Algérie
description: Official statistics website of Algeria's National Statistics Office (ONS). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: Bank of Algeria Statistics
description: Bank of Algeria public statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic tables.

name: Open Data UpGrowth
description: Public catalog of Algerian reference datasets published by UpGrowth under CC BY 4.0, including CNRC activity codes, ANAE auto-entrepreneur activities, wilaya reference data, a Journal officiel index, and customs tariff nomenclature.

name: GeoAlgeria
description: Community atlas of Algeria with an interactive trilingual map of 69 wilayas and 1,541 communes, plus MIT-licensed open geographic datasets (boundaries, post offices, banks, health, transit, and related points of interest) published as JSON, CSV, GeoJSON, and SQL.

name: Aquamap Algérie
owner_name: Centre de Développement des Technologies Avancées
description: Public marine aquaculture geoportal for Algerian coastal waters, mapping aquaculture sites and related marine spatial layers. Developed by CDTA for the National Centre for Fisheries and Aquaculture Research and Development (CNRDPA).

name: INSTAT Dataviz
owner_name: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT Madagascar)
description: Interactive statistical visualization portal of Madagascar's National Institute of Statistics. Presents official indicators by theme and region. The origin behind Cloudflare returned HTTP 521 when last checked (August 2026).

name: OpenStat Madagascar
description: Civil society open data portal operated by Madagascar Initiatives for Digital Innovation (MAIDI). Publishes datasets on public finance, health, economy, education, energy, and society to promote open data and open government in Madagascar.

name: INStaD Benin
owner_name: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie
description: Official statistics website of Benin's National Institute of Statistics and Demography (INStaD). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: SIDoFFE-NG – statistiques sociales publiques
owner_name: Ministère des Affaires Sociales et de la Microfinance
description: Public module of SIDoFFE-NG (Système Intégré des Données relatives à la Famille, la Femme et l'Enfant, Nouvelle Génération). Disseminates official social statistics on family, women, children, disability, and social protection in Benin. The public site is an Angular application; no harvestable catalog API was found.

name: Base de données financière de la Direction Générale du Budget
description: Public financial database of Benin's Direction Générale du Budget (DGB), linked from budgetbenin.bj. Angular application for budget and public-finance datasets. No harvestable catalog API was found at /api (the path serves the SPA).

name: Bank of Namibia Statistical Information
description: Bank of Namibia statistical information catalog of monetary, financial, and macroeconomic tables available as downloadable spreadsheets.

name: Digital Namibia
description: Digital Namibia map browser of the Namibia Statistics Agency. View and analyse NSDI fundamental geospatial datasets from government institutions. NSA lists this geoportal as an official NSDI e-service alongside the GeoFind metadata catalogue.

name: GeoFind NSDI Metadata Catalogue
description: GeoFind NSDI metadata catalogue (Metadata Browser) of the Namibia Statistics Agency. Search and evaluate metadata for government geospatial datasets under the National Spatial Data Infrastructure. NSA still lists this HTTP catalogue as an official e-service alongside Digital Namibia.

name: Environmental Information Service Namibia eLibrary
description: Environmental Information Service Namibia eLibrary. Open catalogue of environmental literature, reports, and spatial datasets compiled with the Namibian Chamber of Environment.

name: SASSCAL Data and Information Portal
owner_name: Southern African Science Service Centre for Climate Change and Adaptive Land Management (SASSCAL)
description: SASSCAL Data and Information Portal. Open metadata catalogue of climate change and adaptive land-management datasets for Southern Africa, hosted by the SASSCAL Open Access Data Centre in Windhoek. HTTPS presents a hostname-mismatched certificate; the public catalogue is served over HTTP.

name: INS Congo
description: Official statistics website of the Republic of the Congo's National Institute of Statistics (INS). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, and economic statistics.

name: ANSTAT Indicateurs
description: Official ANSTAT indicator explorer for Côte d'Ivoire, with thematic time series, charts, and publications. The public site is behind Cloudflare bot protection; the former api-public.anstat.ci host no longer resolves.

name: SIGSEF Côte d'Ivoire
description: Integrated system for economic and financial statistics of Côte d'Ivoire, operated by the Direction Générale de l'Économie. Public multicriteria and predefined table consultation across five sectors (real, monetary, public finance, external, social), with about 84 tables and 1,990 indicators and Excel export. Distinct from the ANSTAT indicator explorer.

name: SIE Cote d Ivoire
owner_name: Ministere de l Environnement, du Developpement Durable et de la Transition Ecologique
description: Système d'Information Environnementale (SIE) of the Ministry of Environment, with thematic environmental indicators and a SIG-SIE GIS module (https://sie.environnement.gouv.ci/sieapp2/sig_index.php). No public catalog API is advertised.

name: SIGFU Plateforme de partage de donnees
owner_name: Ministere de la Construction, du Logement et de l Urbanisme
description: Geographic data-sharing platform of the Ministry of Construction (MCLU) for Greater Abidjan and Assinie (orthophoto, urban database, SDUGA layers), built under the SIGFU / SDUGA programmes. https://sigfu.ci/portal/ times out and does not respond.

name: Base documentaire DGE
description: Document and statistics repository of the Direction Générale de l'Économie, with REST catalog and OAI-PMH. https://documents.economie-ivoirienne.ci currently returns Cloudflare HTTP 530 (tunnel down).

name: ICASEES Centrafrique
owner_name: Institut centrafricain des statistiques, des études économiques et sociales
description: Official statistics website of the Central African Institute of Statistics, Economic and Social Studies (ICASEES). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, and economic statistics. Distinct from the ICASEES NADA microdata catalog.

name: LibyaStat
description: Independent public explorer of Libyan macroeconomic, trade, oil, and exchange-rate indicators compiled from the Central Bank of Libya, the National Oil Corporation, and official trade sources.

name: Libya Spatial Data Portal
description: National spatial data catalog of the Libyan Spatial Data Infrastructure (LSDI / بوابة البيانات المكانية), operated by the General Information Authority. Leaflet catalog of geospatial metadata and map layers shared by Libyan public institutions. No public CSW or OGC API was reachable in August 2026.

name: INSEED Tchad
owner_name: Institut national de la statistique, des études économiques et démographiques
description: Official statistics website of Chad's National Institute of Statistics, Economic and Demographic Studies (INSEED). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, and economic statistics.

name: Observatoire Tchadien des Finances Publiques
description: Public-finance and extractives open-data platform of Chad. Lists budget datasets plus public APIs for petroleum contracts, mining titles, mining conventions, and related authorizations.

name: CLiMIS South Sudan
owner_name: South Sudan National Bureau of Statistics
description: Crop and Livestock Market Information System (CLiMIS) data warehouse of the National Bureau of Statistics and the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security, developed with FAO and partners. Public dashboard of market prices, terms of trade, exchange rates, CPI, cross-border trade, rainfall, crop production, livestock, food-security indicators, and IPC population data.

name: CSRF Research Repository
description: Searchable library of research papers, reports, briefings, and county profiles on conflict sensitivity and aid in South Sudan. Filterable by state, document type, and theme.

name: Eswatini Drought Monitor
description: Public DroughtMap Hub catalog operated by the National Disaster Management Agency. Publishes monthly Composite Drought Indicator maps for browse, compare, and download, with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Eswatini Meteorological Service. Akvo-built Next.js/Django application with a public REST API; rasters are stored on the separate NDMA GeoNode Digital Risk Database.

name: Somalia Livestock Market Information System
owner_name: Ministry of Livestock, Forestry and Range
description: Federal Ministry of Livestock, Forestry and Range Livestock Market Information System. Public portal with analytics, a market data explorer, and reports covering livestock markets and prices across Somali regions.

name: Somalia Ministry of Finance Fiscal Data
description: Federal Ministry of Finance public fiscal tables for FGS budget, expenditure, and revenue (dbSomaliaFgsRevExp) with monthly updates since 2014. Excel, TSV, and CSV annual packages plus a documented machine-readable index API.

name: FSNAU Crop Data
owner_name: Food Security and Nutrition Analysis Unit (FSNAU)
description: FAO FSNAU public crop production explorer for Somalia. Filterable tables of metric-tonne production by zone, region, district, year (1995-2025), season, crop, and livelihood system, with a JSON search-parameter API.

name: FSNAU Early Warning Early Action Dashboard
owner_name: Food Security and Nutrition Analysis Unit (FSNAU)
description: FAO FSNAU Early Warning Early Action dashboard for Somalia. Public district maps and time-series of food-security alarm indicators (markets, climate, nutrition, health, population movement, insecurity, drought).

name: SWALIM Combined Drought Index
owner_name: FAO Somalia Water and Land Information Management (SWALIM)
description: FAO SWALIM Combined Drought Index (CDI) map. Public district drought severity from rainfall and temperature, with CSV download. NDVI is currently excluded from the index.

name: SWALIM Flood Risk and Response Information Management System
owner_name: FAO Somalia Water and Land Information Management (SWALIM)
description: FAO SWALIM Flood Risk and Response Information Management System (FRRMIS). Public river-level tables, forecast maps, river-breakage inventory, and flood map layers for the Juba and Shabelle basins.

name: Somalia National River Flow Archive
owner_name: FAO Somalia Water and Land Information Management (SWALIM)
description: Somalia National River Flow Archive (SNRFA) of FAO SWALIM. Public station catalog for Juba and Shabelle gauges with daily water-level and flow timeseries and downloads (records from 1951 onward).

name: Puntland Water Information Management System
owner_name: Puntland Ministry of Energy, Minerals and Water
description: Puntland Water Information Management System (WIMS) of the Ministry of Energy, Minerals and Water. Public catalog of about 350 water sources with functioning status, quality analytics, rehabilitation projects, and a water resources atlas.

name: CapeFarmMapper 3
description: Online agricultural mapping application of the Western Cape Department of Agriculture. Provides access to cadastral, land cover, biodiversity and farm-level geographic layers.

name: Nelson Mandela Bay GIS Data Downloads
description: Nelson Mandela Bay Municipality public GIS downloads, including cadastral, ward, cemetery and waste-site shapefiles.

name: ISIbalo Data Portal
description: Official Statistics South Africa data product portal. Provides downloadable census, survey and administrative datasets and metadata after the Nesstar service was discontinued.

name: HST District Health Barometer
description: Interactive District Health Barometer of the Health Systems Trust. Public health performance indicators for South Africa's 52 districts, with maps, league tables and downloads.

name: Global Index on Responsible AI
description: Country rankings, pillar and dimension scores, and an evidence explorer assessing responsible artificial-intelligence governance, implementation, civil society participation and enabling conditions worldwide.

name: CSIR GreenBook
owner_name: Council for Scientific and Industrial Research
description: CSIR GreenBook online repository of municipal climate-risk data, projections and adaptation information for South African settlements.

name: SARB Online Statistical Query
description: South African Reserve Bank download facility for Quarterly Bulletin macroeconomic time series. Series can be selected by KBP code or keyword and exported as tables.

name: Stats SA Census Dissemination
description: Interactive Census 2022 dissemination portal of Statistics South Africa. Distinct from the SuperWEB2 table builder; publishes census indicators and geographic profiles as a JavaScript census explorer.

name: Youth Explorer
owner_name: Southern Africa Labour and Development Research Unit, University of Cape Town
description: Youth-centred indicator explorer for South Africa, mapping census, labour market and wellbeing measures from national to ward and main-place level.

name: National Integrated Water Information System
description: National Integrated Water Information System dashboards publishing Department of Water and Sanitation water-resource indicators with CSV and Excel downloads.

name: SARS Trade Stats Portal
description: South African Revenue Service merchandise trade statistics portal, with interactive visualisations and a download wizard for imports and exports by country and commodity.

name: ISS Crime Hub
description: Institute for Security Studies Crime Hub statistics wizard. Compares SAPS crime categories, police stations and reporting years, with maps and downloadable reports.

name: RQIS Water Quality Data and Reports
description: Resource Quality Information Services data and reports for South African river and dam water quality, including chemistry time series and monitoring programme outputs.

name: Spatial Tax Data South Africa
description: There is a glaring gap in the availability of credible spatial economic data in South Africa. This ambitious project draws on administrative tax recor

name: National Treasury Transparency Portal
owner_name: National Treasury Republic of South Africa
description: National Treasury Transparency Portal publishing South African public procurement data as Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) packages, with bulk JSON, CSV and Excel downloads and a REST API.

name: Municipal Finance Data
owner_name: National Treasury Republic of South Africa
description: National Treasury catalog and JSON API for South African municipal Section 71 financial data, covering metro, district and local municipalities.

name: Municipal Money
owner_name: National Treasury Republic of South Africa
description: National Treasury citizen scorecard for municipal financial performance. Profiles indicators, audit outcomes and comparisons for South African municipalities. Machine-readable cubes are published on Municipal Finance Data.

name: Vulekamali – South Africa Budget Data Portal
owner_name: National Treasury Republic of South Africa
description: National Treasury budget transparency portal for South African national and provincial expenditure data, developed with Imali Yethu. The former CKAN datastore at data.vulekamali.gov.za no longer resolves; the public catalog is the vulekamali website.

name: Environmental Geographic Information Systems (EGIS) - Data Download
description: Provides access to baseline geospatial data and services for geospatial technology users.

name: PESA Political Economy Data Portal
description: Former PESA political economy dataset downloads. The hostname politicaleconomy.org.za no longer resolves.

name: SANHO nautical chart catalogue
description: Public catalogue of South African Navy Hydrographic Office paper charts and Electronic Navigational Charts, with ENC usage-band listings (overview, coastal, approaches, harbour) and product metadata. Distinct from the DFFE OCIMS operational portal.

name: South Africa Oceans and Coastal Information Management System
owner_name: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
description: Oceans and Coastal Information Management System of the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment, providing operational marine tools, a coastal viewer, aquaculture and fisheries support, and links to related data resources. Distinct from the CSIR OCIMS CKAN catalog.

name: SANSA Earth Observation Catalogue
description: Earth observation catalogue of the South African National Space Agency. Provides search and ordering of satellite imagery covering southern Africa, including Landsat, SPOT, CBERS and SumbandilaSAT archives.

name: Chief Surveyor-General Spatial Data
owner_name: Chief Surveyor-General, Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
description: Chief Surveyor-General spatial data page for South African cadastral datasets including erven, farms, servitudes and administrative boundaries.

name: National Environmental Screening Tool
owner_name: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
description: National web-based environmental screening tool used to generate mandatory EIA screening reports and inspect spatial environmental sensitivity themes.

name: SAWS Marine Portal
description: Marine data portal of the South African Weather Service: in-situ and remotely sensed ocean observations (SST, sea level, currents, drifting buoys, ships, HF radar, Argo), forecasts and products.

name: Petroleum Agency SA Data Portal
description: Public map of South African petroleum wells, seismic surveys, and licence areas.

name: DIRISA Data Share
owner_name: Data Intensive Research Initiative of South Africa
description: DIRISA national research data services portal, including Data Share for FAIR publication of research datasets with DataCite DOIs and related deposit tools.

name: SAEON Observations Database
owner_name: The South African Environmental Observation Network (SAEON)
description: SAEON observations platform: 36 sites, 267 stations, 1,716 sensors, 1,489 datasets and 67.5M verified observations; public dataset/sensor query at /query/datasets and /query/data.

name: IDIA Public Data Archive
description: Inter-University Institute for Data Intensive Astronomy public data archive, hosting MeerKAT and related radio-astronomy datasets.

name: JWS Online
description: JWS Online is a systems biology repository and browser-based simulator for curated kinetic models, maintained by Stellenbosch University with a Manchester University mirror at this URL. A Stellenbosch instance is also available at https://jjj.biochem.sun.ac.za/.

name: MeerKAT Archive
description: Archive of MeerKAT radio telescope observations operated by the South African Radio Astronomy Observatory.

name: HSRC Research Data Service
description: Former HSRC Research Data Service at curation.hsrc.ac.za. Current public catalog is the HSRC Research Output Repository on Figshare (hsrcrepositoryfigsharecom).

name: South African Weather Service
description: South African Weather Service public website, listed in re3data as a climate data source. Harvestable WIS 2.0 services are recorded separately as wisweathersacoza.

name: South African Environmental Observation Network Open Data Platform
owner_name: The South African Environmental Observation Network (SAEON)
description: The South African Environmental Observation Network (SAEON) Open Data Platform (ODP) is a metadata repository that facilitates the publication, discovery, dissemination, and preservation of earth observation and environmental data in South Africa. SAEON is a long-term environmental observation and research facility of the National Research Foundation (NRF).

name: MARISMA Spatial Data Portal
description: Spatial data used in the MARISMA project (EBSA and MSP workstreams) in an interactive data viewer. Users can select and download files for different countries. Shapefiles require GIS programs, KMZ files require Google Earth. Metadata describes data sources and methods. The portal is managed by the Institute for Coastal and Marine Research, Nelson Mandela University.

name: ODP régional du Sénégal
owner_name: Agence Nationale de la Statistique et de la Démographie (ANSD)
description: ANSD regional Open Data Platform (ODP) for official statistics of Senegal's 14 regions. Distinct from the national AfDB/Knoema Open Data for Africa hub.

name: Géoportail du PGIIS
owner_name: Projet de gestion des inondations et de l'insertion sociale (PGIIS)
description: PGIIS flood-management geoportal cited by Géo Sénégal as the data-exchange platform for inundation management. The public URL is an ArcGIS Enterprise Portal path (/portal/). Distinct from the CKAN site inondations-dakar.org. The TLS handshake currently fails from some networks.

name: Géo Sénégal
owner_name: Agence nationale de l'aménagement du territoire (ANAT)
description: National geospatial data infrastructure portal of Senegal (Géo Sénégal). Publishes Géo Data themes, a cartothèque, and BaseGéo vector/imagery downloads produced with ANAT.

name: West African Vegetation Database
description: Vegetation-plot database for West Africa (phytosociological and dendrometric relevés and floristic inventories), maintained with Cheikh Anta Diop University. Public search is available; a free account is required for full download. HTTPS is not offered. Last data edit noted on the site in January 2023.

name: Cadastre minier du Mali (SICAM)
owner_name: Direction Nationale de la Géologie et des Mines
description: Système Intégré du Cadastre Minier (SICAM / SIGCAM), the public mining-cadastre portal of the Direction Nationale de la Géologie et des Mines. Custom JHipster application (not Trimble Landfolio). Successor to the MCAS repository at mali.revenuedev.org.

name: NENDO - Nos Écoles Nos Données
owner_name: Agence Nationale de Promotion des TIC (ANPTIC)
description: NENDO (Nos Écoles Nos Données) school map and education indicators application from the Burkina Open Data Initiative. Locates preschool and primary schools in selected communes and publishes examination success rates. No public catalog API is exposed.

name: INERA OpenData
owner_name: Institut de l'Environnement et de Recherches Agricoles (INERA)
description: Phytosanitary image and research-data bank of INERA (Direction régionale de recherches environnementales et agricoles de l'Ouest, Bobo-Dioulasso). Publishes labelled and raw smartphone and drone datasets (mango, cashew, rice, cotton; COCO and YOLO formats) from the FONRID-IA project, with a public dataset dashboard and downloads.

name: INE Guiné-Bissau
owner_name: Instituto Nacional de Estatística da Guiné-Bissau
description: Official statistics website of Guinea-Bissau's National Institute of Statistics. Publishes statistical tables and indicators covering census, demography, and economic statistics.

name: National Statistical Office of Malawi
description: Official statistics website of Malawi's National Statistical Office. Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: MIP-1 Monitoring Dashboard
description: Former public indicator warehouse of the National Planning Commission for Malawi 2063 and the First 10-Year Implementation Plan (MIP-1), including SDG tracking, metadata, and downloadable Excel datasets. The mip1dashboard.mw hostname no longer resolves.

name: IFPRI Malawi Datasets Catalog
description: WordPress datasets listing of the IFPRI Malawi Strategy Support Program (MaSSP). Entries are mostly IFPRI Malawi studies deposited in Harvard Dataverse, not a harvestable open-data portal.

name: Institut National de la Statistique de Djibouti (INSTAD)
owner_name: Institut National de la Statistique de Djibouti (INSTAD)
description: INSTAD national statistics website with downloadable statistical yearbooks, monthly and quarterly bulletins, CPI and trade indices, RGPH census reports, and a microdata request form.

name: Cartes nationales du CERD
owner_name: Centre d'Études et de Recherche de Djibouti (CERD)
description: CERD national thematic map gallery covering geology, seismicity, hydrogeology, climate, soils, vegetation, and regional atlas sheets for Djibouti.

name: Portail Interactif de Djibouti
description: GeoHorn territorial portal for Djibouti with Leaflet map dashboards of INSTAD RGPH 2024 census indicators. Demography is published; heritage, health, education, and other themes are being rolled out.

name: Censo 2024 — Angola
description: Official 2024 Population and Housing Census results portal of Angola's Instituto Nacional de Estatística. Publishes a national statistical panorama (36.6 million inhabitants), a provincial explorer, a census atlas, and Excel/PDF downloads covering 76 indicators for all 21 provinces on population, housing, energy, water, sanitation, and education.

name: Plataforma de Monitorização Agro-Climática (INAMET)
description: INAMET agro-climatic monitoring platform for southern Angola (Cunene, Huíla, and Namibe). Publishes province, municipality, and grid indicators for precipitation, temperature, soil water, vegetation health, and drought, plus hydrologic-year bulletins.

name: Banco Nacional de Angola Statistics
description: National Bank of Angola statistics catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: Plateforme Migration INS Niger
description: INS Niger public migration-statistics platform with indicator tables on labour migration, internal displacement, refugee pupils, trafficking, and related themes. HTTP and HTTPS to /migrations/public/indicateurs timed out on 25 August 2026.

name: Système d'Information sur les Marchés Agricoles (SIMA Niger)
owner_name: Ministère du Commerce et de l'Industrie
description: Agricultural market information system of Niger (SIMA). Public weekly price tables by year, month, region, market, and product, with CSV/Excel export. JSON series are served at /_api/prix-produits-agricoles/.

name: Carte Cadastrale — Cadastre Niger
owner_name: Ministère de l'Urbanisme et de l'Habitat
description: Public cadastral map of Cadastre Niger (Ministère de l'Urbanisme et de l'Habitat). Leaflet/OpenLayers viewer with GeoServer WMS layer cadastre:parcelles and parcel pop-ups. Distinct from the paid e-services homepage and from the mining cadastre.

name: Cadastre minier du Niger (e-Mines)
description: Public mining-cadastre map of e-Mines Niger (Ministère des Mines). Lists mineral titles with holders, substances, areas, and a Leaflet/Mapbox map. The application-and-payment homepage is not this catalog.

name: Géoportail - Adressage de la ville de Niamey
owner_name: Agence de Modernisation des Villes du Niger (AMV-Niger)
description: Public addressing geoportal of Niamey operated by Agence de Modernisation des Villes du Niger. Custom OpenLayers map of addressed streets, neighbourhoods, public facilities, and arrondissement boundaries published as GeoJSON layers.

name: Géoportail de la Direction Générale de la Protection Civile
owner_name: Direction Générale de la Protection Civile
description: Public Leaflet geoportal of the Direction Générale de la Protection Civile. Maps disaster events with filters by type, region, and period, plus counts of people, households, and houses affected.

name: BDINA - Base de Données sur les Inondations ANADIA-Niger
owner_name: Cellule de Coordination du Système d'Alerte Précoce (CC/SAP)
description: BDINA flood-impact database for Niger since 1998 (ANADIA). Guest login opens table, map, and chart queries of localities, people affected, and damages. Managed by CC/SAP; the query application is hosted at anadia2.fi.ibimet.cnr.it.

name: ISTEEBU Burundi
owner_name: Institut de statistiques et d’études économiques du Burundi
description: Official statistics website of Burundi's Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (ISTEEBU). Publishes statistical tables and publications covering census, demography, prices, and economic statistics.

name: GBoS Data Portal
description: Official statistics portal of the Gambia Bureau of Statistics (GBoS). Publishes sector indicator tables with CSV, Excel, and PDF downloads covering macroeconomic and financial data, education, health, demography, tourism, agriculture, SDGs, and related official statistics, plus a GIS mapping page.

name: INE Cabo Verde Indicadores
owner_name: Instituto Nacional de Estatística de Cabo Verde
description: National indicators explorer on the website of Cabo Verde's National Institute of Statistics. Disseminates official statistical indicators across socio-economic themes. The site is a custom Angular application without a documented public API.

name: LISGIS Data Bank
owner_name: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services (LISGIS)
description: Statistical data bank of the Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services. Publishes official indicator tables, including monthly Consumer Price Index series, with spreadsheet download. The LISGIS site also points to the NADA microdata catalog and the Open Data for Africa portal.

name: LEITI Data Warehouse
description: Liberia Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (LEITI) public data warehouse. Interactive tables cover extractive-sector revenue, production, exports, employment, social and environmental contributions, active licenses, contracts, and beneficial ownership from 2007 onward.

name: Banque Centrale du Congo - Statistiques
description: Official macroeconomic statistics catalog of the Banque Centrale du Congo. Time series cover the external, monetary and real sectors, with frequency controls and XLSX export.

name: INS RDC Portail Statistique
description: Official statistical indicator portal of the Institut National de la Statistique (INS-RDC). Browse, filter and export national series on inflation, national accounts, poverty, FDI, public debt and mining production.

name: Entrepôt des données minières de la RDC (CTCPM)
owner_name: Cellule Technique de Coordination et de Planification Minière (CTCPM)
description: Mining data warehouse of the DRC (CTCPM). Public registers of mining contracts, operators, industrial projects and mining/quarry titles, with statistics and cartography.

name: Référentiel Géographique Commun (RGC) - RDC
description: Former official data catalog of the Référentiel Géographique Commun (RGC) of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, listing documents, reports and geospatial datasets. The www.rgc.cd host still resolves in DNS but HTTP(S) connections time out as of August 2026.

name: ITIE-RDC Données et Divulgation Systématique
description: Official EITI DRC systematic disclosure portal. Public registers of beneficial owners and extractive contracts, plus mining and petroleum production and revenue figures.

name: ESS StatBank
description: Statistical databank of the Ethiopian Statistical Service. Provides queryable national official statistics and indicator reports across economic and social themes.

name: BOOST Cameroon Open Budget portal
owner_name: Direction Générale du Budget, Ministère des Finances
description: Ministry of Finance BOOST / open-budget portal with interactive tables of Cameroon government revenue and expenditure and downloadable BOOST files from the fichiersBoost section.

name: Plateforme Urbaine du Cameroun
owner_name: Ministère de l'Habitat et du Développement Urbain (MINHDU)
description: National urban geoportal for Cameroon infrastructure and planning data. Public Hydra catalog of resources, projects, and QGIS/MapStore atlases.

name: Lesotho Land Cover Statistics
owner_name: Ministry of Forestry, Range and Soil Conservation
description: Lesotho NextGen land-cover statistics viewer (NextGen-LCDB / NextGen-Atlas / ReNOKA). Annual land-cover indicators prepared for integrated catchment management, developed with the Ministry of Forestry, Range and Soil Conservation and partner institutions.

name: Lesotho Bureau of Statistics
description: Official statistics website and data portal of Lesotho's Bureau of Statistics. Publishes indicator tables and statistical publications covering census, prices, national accounts, and social statistics.

name: Lesotho Statistical Research Portal
description: Statistical Research Portal for Lesotho macroeconomic time series. Browse by category and download series sourced from the Central Bank of Lesotho, Bureau of Statistics, and Ministry of Finance (balance of payments, national accounts, government finance, prices, and monetary survey).

name: Lesotho Soil Information System (LeSIS)
owner_name: Ministry of Forestry, Range and Soil Conservation
description: Lesotho Soil Information System (LeSIS). National soil and land maps from the Ministry of Forestry, Range and Soil Conservation, including primary survey points, secondary products, land maps, and related spatial layers used for digital soil mapping.

name: CAPMAS Egypt
owner_name: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics
description: Official statistics website of Egypt's Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS). The public indicator SPA and REST API on port 8080 serve numeric series for CPI, labour force, foreign trade, and other subjects. Pinned CPI for Total Egypt was 13.0 percent year-on-year in July 2026 (83 monthly observations).

name: Ministry of Finance Data Repository
description: Public data warehouse of the Egyptian Ministry of Finance. Publishes fiscal, revenue, expenditure, debt, and real-sector indicator tables in Arabic and English, plus budget and mid-year review reports.

name: Egypt National Accounts Data
owner_name: Ministry of Planning and Economic Development
description: Interactive national accounts explorer of the Ministry of Planning and Economic Development, publishing GDP, public investment, and governorate accounts tables.

name: Egypt National Observatory for Women
description: Interactive indicators dashboard monitoring Egypt's National Strategy for the Empowerment of Egyptian Women 2030, covering political, economic, social, and protection indicators.

name: CBE Time Series
description: Central Bank of Egypt public time-series catalog of monetary, banking, and macroeconomic indicators.

name: ENHD ENC Online Digital Catalogue
description: Public online catalogue of Electronic Navigational Charts (ENC) produced by the Egyptian Navy Hydrographic Department, listing official ENC cells for Egyptian waters.

name: Atlas of Egyptian Cities
description: Public geoportal of the Ministry of Local Development with interactive city comparisons and atlas levels for urban sustainability and climate indicators across Egyptian cities.

name: Bibliotheca Alexandrina Digital Assets Repository
description: Bibliotheca Alexandrina Digital Assets Repository is a scientific data repository operated by Bibliotheca Alexandrina.

name: Tanzania Census Information Dissemination Platform
description: Official Census Information Dissemination Platform (Census Hub) of Tanzania's National Bureau of Statistics. Provides 2022 Population and Housing Census results, visualizations, publications, and an API for population, buildings, social services, and disability indicators.

name: NeST Open Contracting Data Portal
description: National e-Procurement System of Tanzania (NeST) Open Contracting Data Portal of the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority. Publishes public procurement records as Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS) packages, with search, filters, downloads, and a REST API.

name: Plateforme RIHA
description: Public specimen catalog of the RIHA (Réseau des Herbiers d'Afrique) regional platform. Browseable collections include Herbier National de Guinée (HNG) plus herbaria in Benin, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Gabon, and Togo. Distinct from the inactive Living Atlases datasets host collections.african-herbaria.org and from the network IPT.

name: MINECOFIN Data
owner_name: Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning
description: File catalog of Rwanda government finance statistics (GFSM 2014 workbooks), public debt stock series, and the macro framework dataset.

name: National Bank of Rwanda Statistics
description: National Bank of Rwanda public statistics catalog of monetary, financial, and macroeconomic tables. Distinct from the registration-required FX rates API.

name: Rwanda Data Sharing Platform
description: National Data Sharing Platform of Rwanda. Public catalog of government datasets operated by the Rwanda Information Society Authority (RISA), with a JSON API at api.data.gov.rw.

name: MININFRA Infrastructure Geoportal
description: Ministry of Infrastructure geoportal that previously published public GIS downloads for administrative boundaries, transport, energy, urbanization, and facilities. HTTPS is refused and HTTP times out, so the catalog is treated as offline.

name: BCT Statistiques
description: Banque Centrale de Tunisie public statistical tables covering monetary, banking, and related macroeconomic series, beyond the IMF National Summary Data Page.

name: Tunisia Data Portal
description: INS Tunisia data portal for analyzing, visualizing, and reporting official statistical indicators for Tunisia and its governorates. No public machine-readable API was found beyond the website.

name: Portail Mizaniatouna du Ministère des Finances
description: Ministry of Finance BOOST / open-budget portal (Mizaniatouna) with interactive visualizations of Tunisian government budget allocations and expenditure.

name: Plateforme du Budget ouvert de la Tunisie
description: Open-budget platform of the Tunisian Ministry of Finance with public dashboards of government expenditure by programme, operational unit, and economic nature.

name: Données ouvertes du Ministère de l'Intérieur
description: Sectoral open data portal of the Tunisian Ministry of Interior, listing public datasets on security, civil protection, and interior administration.

name: Portail sectoriel des données ouvertes du transport
description: Sectoral open data portal of the Tunisian Ministry of Transport, publishing transport networks, stops, and related public datasets. The former CKAN API is no longer available.

name: Portail des données agricoles ouvertes
owner_name: Ministère de l'Agriculture, des Ressources Hydrauliques et de la Pêche
description: Open data portal of the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, publishing agricultural, water, and fisheries datasets for Tunisia. The former CKAN API is no longer available.

name: OTC Géoportail cadastral
owner_name: Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre
description: Cadastral geoportal of the Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre (OTC), providing web-GIS access to Tunisian cadastral and topographic information.

name: Registre National des Données Publiques
owner_name: Présidence du Gouvernement - Unité de l'Administration Électronique
description: National Register of Public Data (registre.data.gov.tn / PDIMS), the inventory of datasets produced by Tunisian public bodies. Complementary to the national open data portal at data.gov.tn.

name: Bactibase: database dedicated to bacteriocins
owner_name: Higher Institute of Applied Biological Sciences of Tunis (ISSBAT)
description: BACTIBASE contains calculated or predicted physicochemical properties of bacteriocins produced by both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria. The information in the database allows rapid prediction of structure/function relationships and target organisms of these peptides, supporting medical and food applications.

name: Geodata Togo
description: National institutional geoportal of Togo (Geodata Togo / Géoportail institutionnel), a custom map catalogue also served at geoportail.gouv.tg. Public layers are published through GeoServer WMS, WCS, and WMTS; WFS is not publicly accessible.

name: FertiTogo
description: ITRA soil fertility information system for Togo. Publishes regional fertility maps (pH, organic matter, available phosphorus, exchangeable potassium, and salinity) as downloadable products, plus crop fertilizer recommendation sheets and an interactive advisor built from soil samples collected across the country.
